review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: unverified — The code now gives Overview's activity() the coach link's targets for the athlete (targetsFor(coach?.link)), the same value TrendsTab uses. No manual proof is attached.
- A2: unverified — The caption and RateBars band read targets.rateLow and targets.rateHigh in both views. There are no screenshots showing 10–14.
- A3: met — targets.test.ts covers link targets present, targets null/undefined/missing, and link null/undefined.

<details><summary>4 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- Check that useBackend, DEFAULT_TARGETS and AthleteTargets are still used `src/app/cloud/TrendsTab.tsx:10` — Drop any import that is no longer referenced.
- RateBars lost its doc comment, and lo/hi are now required `src/components/charts.tsx:64` — Restore the comment, e.g. `/** Breathing rate per open session, against the lo–hi br/min target band. */`, and confirm there are no other callers.
- Document the new Workspace fields `src/app/cloud/AthleteWorkspace.tsx:36` — Add `/** The coach link's targets (the first coach's for athletes); defaults when unset. */` and `/** The athlete's first coach; only set in the athlete's own view. */`.
- An athlete's coach lookup failing now fails the whole workspace `src/app/cloud/AthleteWorkspace.tsx:56` — Keep as is, or catch inside firstCoach and fall back to null with a visible notice.

</details>

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: Check that useBackend, DEFAULT_TARGETS and AthleteTargets are still used
suggestions.detail: The diff removed the only visible uses of `backend` and the local `targets: AthleteTargets` annotation in TrendsTab, but kept the `useBackend` and `DEFAULT_TARGETS, type AthleteTargets` imports. If the Targets component in this file doesn't use them, lint reports unused imports, and CONSTRAINTS.md requires no new warnings. I can't tell from the diff.
suggestions.repro: Run `npm run lint` on the branch and look for unused-import warnings in TrendsTab.tsx.
suggestions.fix: Drop any import that is no longer referenced.

suggestions.title: RateBars lost its doc comment, and lo/hi are now required
suggestions.detail: The JSDoc above RateBars was deleted instead of updated, while neighbouring components keep theirs. Making `lo`/`hi` required breaks any other RateBars caller not shown in this diff; typecheck would catch it.
suggestions.repro: Run `npm run typecheck`, or grep for `<RateBars` outside AthleteOverview.tsx.
suggestions.fix: Restore the comment, e.g. `/** Breathing rate per open session, against the lo–hi br/min target band. */`, and confirm there are no other callers.

suggestions.title: Document the new Workspace fields
suggestions.detail: Every neighbouring field has a one-line doc comment (e.g. rules: "The coach's alert rules; defaults for athletes."). `targets` and `coachName` have none, and coachName is only set in the athlete's own view.
suggestions.fix: Add `/** The coach link's targets (the first coach's for athletes); defaults when unset. */` and `/** The athlete's first coach; only set in the athlete's own view. */`.

suggestions.title: An athlete's coach lookup failing now fails the whole workspace
suggestions.detail: Before, a failed listCoaches/getCoachLink in TrendsTab only meant default targets. Now it rejects the workspace Promise.all, and the athlete sees the sessions ErrorState instead of their data. Surfacing the error matches CONSTRAINTS.md; this is noted only as a behaviour change.
suggestions.repro: In the athlete's own view, make backend.data.listCoaches reject.
suggestions.fix: Keep as is, or catch inside firstCoach and fall back to null with a visible notice.

The caption and RateBars band read targets.rateLow and targets.rateHigh in both views. There are no screenshots showing 10–14.
